executionPolicy: Parent operating policy, not automatic enforcement or evidence of execution: no gates were run by this documentation-only edit; previously collected receipts retain their original scope and identity and are not refreshed by this policy. Concrete commands for future native/domain fixtures must be established before gate activation. All writers must release before gates; run only one CPU-bound gate at a time, with read-only investigation allowed to overlap. Default outer wall-clock caps: focused gate 300s; core CI 1200s; full strict coverage 900s; graph build/check/verify 300s; shared discovery 120s; private offline helper 30s. Existing tighter per-test and operation limits remain unchanged, including the Worker bundle 15s limit; no timeout increases without measurement and review. Use supervised processes, observe readiness where applicable rather than inferring it from process creation, and capture private receipts recording the exact command, toolchain and dependency identity, source revision or uncommitted-state identity, start/end times, exit status, elapsed time and counter results. Checkpoint and reassess at 15-minute wall-clock intervals instead of blindly repeating work. During diagnosis, rerun only changed or failing scope; unchanged successful evidence is reusable only until its inputs, toolchain or dependencies change. Finish diagnosis with one complete stable-candidate acceptance. Budget expiry is failure or uncertainty, never green; do not automatically retry stateful or privileged operations. Run GitHub gates only after green local acceptance of an immutable commit. Graph, browser and deployment gates are conditional on actual changed scope and satisfied prerequisites, not substitutes for missing evidence. Do not switch platforms to evade local failures or duplicate billed checks. Local runtime gates do not prove remote or provider readiness. Do not arbitrarily exclude source or coverage to meet a budget.
